subject: When the mattress is only one part of the problem
preheader: Complex sleep setups need the bed, mattress, transfers, assistance and room to work together.
intro: For a person with complex physical support needs, choosing a mattress in isolation can miss the harder part of the brief.
The bed height, positioning, transfer equipment, room access and the way assistance is provided all have to work as one setup.
sectionTitle: Test the interaction, not only the individual products
body: A mattress may support one goal while the bed height makes a transfer harder. An accessory may help positioning but obstruct access for a family member or support worker.
A useful home trial brings those dependencies into the same discussion before the final equipment recommendation.
questions: Can the person be positioned and repositioned as intended?
Can assistance be provided safely from the space available?
Do the bed, mattress and transfer equipment work together in the actual room?
actionText: Tell us about the person's needs and goals, their support routine, the room and the equipment already being used. We can help work out what should be tested together and whether an in-home trial is practical.
teamName: The Sleep Choice x Supply Ministry Team
trialFooterText: Seven-night in-home trial availability, service area, equipment configuration and individual arrangements are confirmed per case.
